# 360 View Film Crew

> 360 View Film Crew is a Central Florida photography company that creates connected 360° Google tours and professionally edited photos for local businesses, and publishes them to the business's Google Maps listing, Google Business Profile and Street View. Packages run $395 to $795, paid in person at the shoot. Rated 5.0 from 37 Google reviews (October 2026).

## Key facts

- Service ("Google Visibility"): a connected 360° walkthrough of the business plus professionally edited point-of-interest photos, published to Google Maps, Google Business Profile and Street View.
- Every package includes: an exterior/entrance 360° viewpoint, professional image editing, Google Maps, Google Business Profile and Street View publishing, embed code to put the tour on the business's own website with no hosting fees, and commercial usage rights to the photos.
- Packages:
  - Google Visibility, $395: 10 connected 360° photospheres and 10 edited point-of-interest photos. For smaller spaces and single-room businesses.
  - Google Visibility+, $595 (most popular): 20 connected 360° photospheres and 20 edited point-of-interest photos. For most businesses.
  - Total Visibility, $795: 30 connected 360° photospheres and 30 edited point-of-interest photos. For large or multi-area spaces.
  - Custom interactive 360 experiences are quoted separately.
- Payment: at the shoot. Booking is free and there is no deposit. No monthly fee.
- Shoot timing: usually first thing at opening when it's quiet; some spaces are shot while closed.
- Service area: based in Central Florida (Polk County), serving Central and South Florida from the Gulf Coast to the Atlantic Coast and the I-4 corridor, including Lake Wales, Winter Haven, Lakeland, Bartow, Haines City, Davenport, Kissimmee, Plant City, Brandon, Tampa Bay and Orlando.
- Founder and lead photographer: Jake.
- Contact: call or text (863) 244-2054. Book a time: https://calendar.app.google/eQEj3reuLJ5Dr1bd8
- Google Business Profile: https://maps.google.com/?cid=14531085279498045763
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/people/360-View-Film-Crew/61564586767416/

- [Smoke shops](https://gogeolocal.com/smoke-shops/): 360° Google tours and photos for smoke and vape shops, which can't run Google or Facebook ads, so their Google listing works as their billboard
- [Reviews](https://gogeolocal.com/reviews/): Google reviews from Florida business owners

## FAQ

- When do I pay? At the shoot. Booking a time is free and there is no deposit.
- Is there a monthly fee? No. The tour is published to Google and can be embedded on your website with no monthly hosting fee. Only custom interactive experiences are quoted separately.
- Which package do I need? It depends on the size of the space: up to 10, 20 or 30 connected 360° photospheres. Jake recommends one after seeing the space.
- Can I put the tour on my own website? Yes. Every package includes embed code for your website.
- Who owns the photos? Every package includes commercial usage rights for your website, social media and ads.
- Do I need to close during the shoot? Usually not. Many shoots happen first thing at opening; some spaces are best shot while closed.
- Smoke shops: shoots happen with lights, neon and display cases on. A tour on your own Google Business Profile is not a paid ad, so it isn't subject to the ad restrictions on tobacco and vape promotions. Most single-room shops fit Google Visibility ($395); shops with a glass room, lounge or several rooms usually choose Google Visibility+ ($595).
